description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1.
- Reads images and PDFs. Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify.
name: Read

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

limit.description: The number of lines to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from
